title: finance-budget-1on1-prep-maya
content:
Meeting: 1:1 w/ Ben Carter (Finance lead) — prep notes
Date: 2026-03-02 10:00am
Goal: Quick sync on run-rate, urgent procurement approvals, and Q2 commit asks (Dedicated capacity + headcount holds)

Topline to surface:
- Current blended run-rate (approx) = $3.1M / month (incl payroll, infra, SaaS) — verify master sheet before call (see GSHEET link).
- Biggest levers this quarter: infra (GPUs + cloud), headcount (open reqs), and vendor renewals (logging/metrics).
- Procurement approvals pending: Vendor A (infra tools) $62k annual -> threshold requires CFO signoff; Vendor B (security scanning) $18k -> can approve via infra lead.

Open items I need Ben's read on:
1) Q2 Dedicated capacity commit: engineering asking for 4 reserved gpu pools (est $420k/yr).
   - ask: can we approve a Q2 pilot commit if we structure as 3-mo eval? fallback = monthly on-demand (higher unit cost).
   - question: finance preference for CAPEX vs OPEX treatment here? (impacts forecasting)
2) Hiring: 6 IC reqs flagged as priority by Eng — we currently have hiring freeze partial. What's the bar for exceptions? 
   - propose: approve 2 critical infra hires (SRE senior + Runtime eng) if cost can be absorbed by Q2 underspend.
3) Run-rate accuracy: payroll run-rate in sheet looks +6% vs last month due to sign-on bonuses & contractors. Need confirmation on contractor end-dates (Tom has list).

Quick numbers to call out (scratchy):
- Payroll: ~$1.9M / mo (inc benefits)
- Infra + Cloud: ~$650k / mo (GPUs + cloud infra, storage, bandwidth)
- SaaS + Tools: ~$210k / mo (observability, security, analytics)
- Others (office, travel, misc): ~$340k / mo

Procurement queue (items I want Ben to greenlight or advise):
- PO-2026-118 Vendor A (infra tools) — $62k/yr — needs CFO signoff (why OK: reduces ops toil + 20% perf improvement)
- PO-2026-121 Vendor B (security) — $18k/yr — infra lead approval ok
- One-off hardware request (on-prem kit for private deployment demo) — est $95k -> capital purchase conversation

Risks / tradeoffs to mention:
- Large Dedicated commit reduces per-token cost but increases fixed spend; want finance comfort for 12mo vs 3mo window.
- If we pause hires, runway extends but delivery risk on infra reliability.
- Procurement approvals backlog will delay security tooling rollout (compliance risk for some customers).

Proposed asks during 1:1:
- Can finance provision provisional sign-off for up to $100k of critical procurement this quarter given product SLAs? (Ben check internal limit)
- Guidance on buy vs rent for Dedicated pilot (prefer 3-mo eval w/ opt-out after 90 days).
- Quick decision window for 2 headcount exceptions — if yes, I'll prepare justification packet + ROI (to Ben) by EOD Thu.

Prep checklist (for me):
- [ ] Validate numbers in GSHEET (payroll, infra) — assigned: Maya — due Thu EOD
- [ ] Collect contractor end-dates (Tom) — due Wed
- [ ] Draft procurement justification for Vendor A (attach perf data & cost model) — Maya -> send to Ben before call
- [ ] Draft 2-headcount exception forms + hiring scorecards — ask Eng to fill by Wed

Notes to self (if Ben pushes back):
- Be ready to propose phased capacity: start smaller reserved pool + autoscale for spikes. Show unit economics (cost/token) with and without commit.
- If CFO requires CAPEX approval timeline — propose interim OPEX billing through Dedicated vendor credit to avoid missing customer demos.

Follow-ups (after 1:1):
- Owner: Maya -> update GSHEET & send summary email w/ action items and timelines (1 business day after meeting).
- Owner: Ben -> confirm procurement sign-off thresholds and whether he can approve Vendor A up to $75k this quarter.
- Owner: Tom -> finalize contractor end-dates and share with finance for run-rate adj.

Scratchpad / questions to ask Ben live:
- "If we do 3-mo pilot for Dedicated, can finance reclassify as operational expense to speed procurement?"
- "What's the fastest path to get CFO eyes on PO>50k?"
- "Any preferred vendor procurement cadence (weekly ops review?)"

Attachments to prepare:
- One-pager: Dedicated commit ROI (ppt)
- Cost model spreadsheet (GSHEET link)
- Procurement justification template (short doc)

-- end of notes --
